Class Syntax

java.lang.Object
forj.Syntax
public final class Syntax extends Object
Extension methods for the type classes, like cats' syntax imports: fa.map(f) on any F<A> with a Functor<F>, a.combine(b) on any A with a Semigroup<A>. The forj plugin always searches here last, so they need no import. Methods a type has itself win: io.map(f) calls IO.map.

Error-handling syntax fixes the error type to Throwable, as Sync does.
